value.rationale: Determines an entire natural two-parameter sharp universal extension trace for weighted stars, including the exact loss of support of the exceptionally long leaf and an eventual dimension plateau. Such a support-extinction threshold is not a routine substitution into the known equal-arm star result; the extreme domain metric and target class motivate the exact constant. No claim for arbitrary weights or p<1 is made.
